description: We are storytellers, builders, and dreamers united by a shared fascination with the cosmos. Bringing together skills in creative writing, visual design, and software development, we view space not just as a frontier of science, but as the ultimate canvas for human connection.
summary:
THE LAST SIGNAL explores one of the greatest challenges of space exploration: maintaining communication with spacecraft travelling millions of kilometres from Earth. As robotic explorers venture deeper into space, communication delays, weak signals, environmental conditions, and limited power can make every transmission critical.

Our platform transforms these challenges into an interactive learning experience. Users explore fictional mission scenarios inspired by real NASA missions, understand how spacecraft communicate with Earth, and discover what happens when signals become delayed or interrupted.

By combining NASA space communication resources, scientific information, and interactive storytelling, THE LAST SIGNAL aims to make deep-space communication understandable and exciting. Our goal is to inspire curiosity about space technology, engineering, and the future of interplanetary exploration.
details:
THE LAST SIGNAL is an interactive educational platform exploring the challenges of communicating with spacecraft across deep space. It demonstrates how distance, signal delays, weak transmissions, and spacecraft limitations affect communication with Earth.

Users experience simulated mission scenarios, explore communication challenges, and learn how NASA tracks and receives information from distant spacecraft. Inspired by real space missions, the platform combines storytelling, scientific information, and interactive learning to explain the importance of every signal sent across space.

Our goal is to make deep-space communication accessible, encourage interest in aerospace engineering, and help people understand the technology connecting Earth with the universe.
